system.description:
You used to be a foe to the heroes, but you've changed your stripes. You may have realized the evil of your former ways, or your motivation might have changed to ally you with those you once fought. Either way, you are now a hero, though many other heroes are hesitant to trust you.

Qualities

Assign a d10 and a d8 to two of these qualities:

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.qualities.Item.yFhNXz31ZVkgf6Vp]{Conviction}

• Select from Information qualities category

• Select from Social qualities category

Principle

Choose an Expertise principle.

Power Source

Roll d10, d8, d8 for power source selection.
